sections.title: Intro – Iconic Bb Major Piano Ballad (M. 1–8)
sections.character: The world-famous Freddie Mercury piano intro. Flowing Bb-Gm-Cm-F arpeggios.

sections.title: Verse 1 – "Mama, just killed a man" (M. 9–16)
sections.character: Haunting storytelling. Let the right hand vocal line soar over the rocking chords.

sections.title: Verse 2 – "Mama, life had just begun" (M. 17–24)
sections.character: Emotional build-up. Warmer bass octaves and soaring vocal melody.

sections.title: Climax & Outro – "Carry on, carry on" (M. 25–33)
sections.character: Grand emotional climax resolving into the gentle "nothing really matters" fade.

annotations.title: The Iconic Freddie Mercury Piano Touch
annotations.instruction: Articulate the opening Bb major eighth-note arpeggios with crisp clarity and gentle rhythmic pulse. Avoid over-pedaling so the internal harmonic shifts (Bb - Gm - Cm - F) ring out transparently.

annotations.title: Vocal Melody Projection ("Mama")
annotations.instruction: Give the right-hand pinky and fourth finger firm arm weight on the melody (D5, Bb4, C5). Keep the left-hand bass octaves resonant but deep beneath the voice.

annotations.title: Climax & Gentle Resolution
annotations.instruction: Lean passionately into the chromatic bass descent on "Carry on", then gradually soften dynamics towards the final tender cadence.
